summary: Create the credential under Automation Decisions > Infrastructure > Credentials with type Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, the controller URL (https://<gateway_host>/api/controller/ on 2.6, or https://<controller_host> for controller 2.4) and username/password or OAuth token. It breaks after a backup/restore to new hostnames until you update it.

answer_card.title: Red Hat AAP credential for EDA
answer_card.answer_md:
*Automation Decisions > Infrastructure > Credentials > Create credential*, type **Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform**.

- URL on AAP 2.6: `https://<your_gateway_host>/api/controller/`
- URL for EDA 2.6 with controller 2.4: `https://<your_controller_host>`
- Then a username and password, or an OAuth token.

After a backup/restore to a new cluster or hostnames, edit the URL and credentials or activations will fail.
